channel.title: The Hockey News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Hockey News (thehockeynews.com)

item.title: Prospect Power Rankings: Beware Of Barrie And Beaudoin
item.description: The best developmental teams with the best future NHL talents in North America has the hottest squad in all of junior hockey in first place.

item.title: The Los Angeles Kings Should Make Two Big Moves To Avoid Missing The Playoffs
item.description: The Los Angeles Kings have been mired in a tailspin in their past 14 games, and they currently are out of a playoff spot in the Western Conference. Is it time to change the coach?

item.title: Hurricanes Prospect Justin Robidas Was Born To Speed
item.description: Justin Robidas' speed has helped him get to open ice and fire pucks on net like not many others in the AHL. And his father, a former NHL player and current Montreal Canadiens assistant coach, continues to help him improve.

item.title: Boston Bruins Will Reward Their Players In The Trade Market Without Going Too Crazy
item.description: The Boston Bruins have exceeded expectations after starting a retool last year, but they're still clinging to the final wild-card berth in the Eastern Conference.

item.title: NHL's Top Four Center Trade Candidates Ahead Of Deadline
item.description: The 2026 NHL trade deadline is rapidly approaching. These are the top centers in the rumor mill right now, for the March 6 deadline.

item.title: Jack Hughes' Gold Medal Grin Shines Light On Repairing The 'Hockey Smile'
item.description: The NHL has several classic hockey smiles that feature missing or broken teeth. New Jersey Devils' Jack Hughes has become a part of that club after his teeth were broken in the Olympic gold medal game. Dr. Anjali Rajpal explains the process behind repairing a hockey smile.

item.title: How Has The J.T. Miller Trade Fared For The Rangers And Canucks A Year Later?
item.description: It's been just over a year since J.T. Miller was traded to the New York Rangers following drama with the Vancouver Canucks. How has the trade fared for both teams since then?

item.title: Director Of Black Hockey Documentary 'Soul On Ice' Reflects On Its Impact 10 Years Later
item.description: Kwame Mason's debut film continues to have an impact on the hockey world when it comes to showing the importance of the Black hockey story from the game's past, present, and looking forward to its future with diverse talent.

item.title: Three NHL Trade Deadline Predictions: Biggest Return, Surprise Buyers, And More
item.description: The NHL's trade deadline is under a week away. That means it's time for some bold predictions as to what we'll see on the trade front by the deadline. Which teams will dominate the trade market? Which veteran players will get the biggest trade return this year?

item.title: Calder Trophy Is Schaefer's To Lose, With Respect To Habs' Demidov And Ducks' Sennecke
item.description: The Calder Trophy is New York Islanders defenseman Matthew Schaefer's to lose, despite impressive rookie campaigns from Montreal Canadiens right winger Ivan Demidov and Anaheim Ducks right winger Beckett Sennecke.
